sources.finding: Offline/firewalled Transformers use requires files downloaded and cached ahead of time.
HF_HOME and HF_HUB_CACHE can alter cache roots.
A cached revision has a snapshot_path under snapshots/<commit> with the repo tree.
Safetensors metadata parsing is structural; full SHA-256 remains the byte-authenticity proof.

decision: downstream public trace acceptance must require selected snapshot path, loader binding, and full model.safetensors digest fields in provenance and NPZ metadata.
